$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # transforms
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/echo
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/looped
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper/echo
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled/echo
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/looped
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/upper
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/looped
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/looped/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/upper
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/upper/echo
PASS
$ cat testdata/script/twice.txtar
echo prints a1 six.
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
a1 six
-- out/echo/inputs --
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- out/echo/outcome --
accepted
-- out/echo/values.txt --
a1 six
-- transform/looped/in/do/error --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- transform/looped/in/resolve/error --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- transform/looped/out/echo/error.txt --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- transform/looped/out/echo/inputs --
error.txt
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- transform/looped/out/echo/outcome --
rejected
-- transform/looped/out/echo/values.txt --
a1 six
-- transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt --
A1 SIX
-- transform/upper/out/echo/inputs --
values.txt
  transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt
-- transform/upper/out/echo/outcome --
accepted
-- transform/upper/out/echo/values.txt --
A1 SIX
$ cat testdata/script/errs.txtar
echo errs on a cycle, and prints part of its values.
-- in/do/error --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
partial
-- properties --
circular
-- out/echo/error.txt --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- out/echo/inputs --
error.txt
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- out/echo/outcome --
rejected
-- out/echo/values.txt --
partial
-- transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt --
PARTIAL
-- transform/upper/out/echo/error.txt --
A1 -> A1: cycle
-- transform/upper/out/echo/inputs --
error.txt
values.txt
  transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt
-- transform/upper/out/echo/outcome --
rejected
-- transform/upper/out/echo/values.txt --
PARTIAL
$ cat testdata/script/garbled.txtar
A case that states malformed, which no transform gives or keeps.
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
x
-- properties --
malformed
-- out/echo/inputs --
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- out/echo/outcome --
accepted
-- out/echo/values.txt --
x
